// diagnostic E0083

Jet.UnclosedDelimiter

`{open}` opened on line {line} is never closed

What

`{open}` opened on line {line} is never closed

Why

Every `{open}` needs a matching `{close}`, but {cutoff} came first

Fix

Add `{close}` where the {construct} ends

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnclosedDelimiter: Tests/UI/Modules/env_role_module_field_without_call_commas_reports_once.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnclosedDelimiter: `(` opened on line 5 is never closed
  --> Tests/UI/Modules/env_role_module_field_without_call_commas_reports_once.jet:5:24
    |
  5 |         DB_URL: compose(
    |                        ^
  --> Tests/UI/Modules/env_role_module_field_without_call_commas_reports_once.jet:6:26
    |
  6 |             template: url
    |                          ^ the end of the line comes before the closing `)`
 Why: Every `(` needs a matching `)`, but the end of the line came first
 Fix: Add `)` where the call ends
